The design assigns different amounts of extra reading to different grade levels (8th graders get 4 hours, 7th graders get 2 hours, 6th graders get 0 hours). Grade level is a lurking variable that is completely confounded with the treatment: any observed differences in GPA could be due to grade-level differences (maturity, curriculum, etc.) rather than the amount of reading. This confounding makes it impossible to isolate the effect of reading time.

ANSWER: D
